notes.title: New update!
notes.content:
The changes were made: 
• Monsters. Their location on the map and the number. 
• Changed the presentation of the text, for the sake of greater clarity. 
• Changed the location of the control key, now it carries with it one of the monsters. 
• Some minor improvements that do not seriously affect the game.
